description.fun: A Fossilized Fish upside down on a Fossilized Dino. It can catch prey by freezing everything around it, but with its mouth on top of its head, eating it afterwards is a struggle. Its upper half may echo Ainiktozoon, a Scottish fossil that was once reconstructed upside down.
description.guide: A Water and Ice-type Fossil Pokémon from Pokémon Sword and Shield, restored from the Fossilized Fish and the Fossilized Dino. Its face is impervious to attack, but its Pokédex says breathing trouble drove it extinct.
description.tagline: An upside-down fossil with its mouth on top of its head
